findings.problem: "it's where most of the correct facts AI gives about Vega come from" goes further than the claim on two counts. Scope: C-136 says the Anthropic story is the source of most correct customer, speed and data-handling facts, not most correct facts about Vega in general. Source: the evidence is one story (claude.com/customers/vega), but "it's" reads as customers' and partners' sites in general.
findings.evidence: C-136 (HIGH, CONFIRMED): 'is the source of most correct customer, speed and data-handling facts (41-second CloudTrail scan, 25-to-3-minute triage, Bedrock zero data retention, Frankfurt EU control plane)'. C-205 (MEDIUM) is the recommendation and relies on C-136.
findings.fix: Say the Anthropic story is where most of the correct customer, speed and data-handling facts come from (patch 3).

findings.problem: "the answer to the 'you already own X' losses" claims the docs would fix the problem, but the evidence only says they would give AI something to cite. The incumbents in those losses are CrowdStrike, Cribl and Databricks. Snowflake was not one of them, so the phrase also overstates how far the three named partners line up with the losses.
findings.evidence: C-088 (MEDIUM, CONFIRMED): four incumbent losses, where the buyer already runs CrowdStrike, Cribl Stream or Databricks. C-206 (MEDIUM): partner docs 'give AI a citable run-it-beside-what-you-have answer'.
findings.fix: Present it as aimed at those losses rather than as their answer (patch 2).

findings.problem: "so another Vega's facts stop answering for yours" promises the result. C-210 only says the recommendation 'directly targets' the 13 brand-collision errors. A small softening states the aim without guaranteeing it.
findings.evidence: C-210 (HIGH, CONFIRMED) business_impact: 'Directly targets the 13 brand-collision errors'; C-184: 13 of 34 confirmed errors are wrong-entity.
